title: A die carried into the next shop
description: In the Black Market, the Dice House's die is carried left through the Clothing Shop, a shop's room, so no one minds. Carried on out of it, the die angers the nearest Shopkeeper: the Clothing Shop's runs out after the player, while the Dice House's stays where he is.
